prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a striking ultra-detailed 4:5 black-and-white fine-art studio portrait of a mature adult man matching the required approved adult non-public-figure identity reference. Preserve the reference's facial structure, eye shape, nose proportions, jawline, hairline, natural skin texture, and adaptive beard density without artificial smoothing. He wears a dark black crewneck sweater and holds a classic thinker pose with one hand raised to the chin, thumb along the jawline, index finger slightly curled, and a serious contemplative gaze toward camera. Use a tight symmetrical head-and-shoulders crop, a pure black background, a large soft directional key slightly above and left of camera, minimal front fill, subtle rim separation, natural catchlights, deep but detailed shadows, realistic hand anatomy, neutral monochrome tonality, wide dynamic range, and refined micro-contrast.
